pairs.name: M101 central field · real SPHEREx
pairs.credit: SPHEREx / NASA / JPL-Caltech; served by Caltech/IPAC IRSA

alignment.method: Astropy celestial WCS with SIP distortion; bilinear reprojection onto one ICRS TAN grid

differenceBlockers: Background/photometric fit is exploratory and has not been validated as a correction
Native-pixel and calibration covariance are not supplied in the diagonal VARIANCE extension
Spatially varying recommended ePSF has not been matched

warnings: Real SPHEREx quick-release observations. Calibration and image-quality artifacts may remain.
Each detector pixel has its own wavelength. The pair uses nearby, not identical, effective wavelengths; incompatible pixels are masked.
Wavelengths use the pinned CWAVE/CBAND spectral calibration product, matched to every exposure. No 102-channel spectrum is inferred from a single frame.
Both frames use the same MJy/sr display range. No independent per-frame brightness normalization is applied. Zodiacal background has not been subtracted.
Independent compact-source centroid fits and PSF/noise diagnostics are documented in the linked numerical report. These are visual-comparison checks, not a significant-change measurement.
Reprojection interpolates pixels and correlates noise. This viewer does not establish statistically significant motion or variability.
pairs.interpretation: The field contains the central region of M101 (the Pinwheel Galaxy). Compare the galaxy and surrounding sources at two real observation dates. No motion or statistically verified brightness change is claimed. Differences may reflect noise, residual alignment, wavelength response or calibration.
